title: POV Learning: Individual Alignment of Multimodal Models via Human Perception
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'POV Learning', which aligns multimodal models with individual subjective perception using eye-tracking data. The benchmark task (Perception-guided Crossmodal Entailment) evaluates the coherence between image captions and visual focus. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks, though it mentions 'values' in a general motivational context for AI alignment.
